Phase 1: AWS Account / STS Foundation
- Initialized Java 21 Spring Boot 3 modular monolith backend with Maven Wrapper (`mvnw`, `mvnw.cmd`).
- Implemented AWS SDK for Java 2.x STS provider layer behind clean abstraction `StsIdentityProvider`.
- Implemented `AwsStsIdentityProvider` handling `getCallerIdentity()` and `assumeRole(AssumeRoleRequest)` with safe domain exception mapping (`AwsAuthenticationException`, `AwsIdentityException`).
- Created in-memory session model `AssumedRoleSession` and `CallerIdentity` ensuring zero leakage of secrets or credentials.
- Created REST endpoint `GET /api/v1/aws/identity` returning `accountId`, `arn`, and `userId`.
- Configured Spring Boot global exception advice (`GlobalExceptionHandler`) to ensure clean structured JSON responses.
- Implemented comprehensive unit tests (`AwsStsIdentityProviderTest`, `AwsIdentityServiceTest`, `AwsIdentityControllerTest`, `CloudOpsApplicationTests`) passing 100% without requiring external AWS connection.
- Executed live integration test (`AwsStsIntegrationTest`) and end-to-end verification against live AWS account (`351405419700`).

Phase 2: AWS Resource Discovery & Inventory Foundation
- Implemented normalized AWS resource model (`CloudResource`, `Ec2InstanceResource`, `S3BucketResource`, `RdsInstanceResource`, `VpcResource`, `SecurityGroupResource`, `IpPermissionRule`, `InventorySummary`).
- Implemented provider layer for EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, and Security Groups with multi-page pagination support (`describeInstancesPaginator`, `describeDBInstancesPaginator`, `describeSecurityGroupsPaginator`).
- Configured Spring client beans for `Ec2Client`, `S3Client`, `RdsClient` using AWS SDK v2 default credentials provider.
- Implemented `AwsResourceDiscoveryService` orchestrating multi-service inventory aggregation and account identity binding.
- Implemented read-only REST endpoints: `GET /api/v1/aws/resources`, `/ec2`, `/s3`, `/rds`, `/vpcs`, `/security-groups` supporting explicit region filtering.
- Implemented comprehensive unit test suite (20 tests) passing 100% with zero live credential dependencies.
- Tested and verified live REST endpoints with structured JSON responses and error translation.

Phase 3: EC2 Deep Inspection + Observability Foundation
- Implemented **Milestone 3A (API Security & Error Hardening)**: Created `AwsErrorTranslator` and enhanced `GlobalExceptionHandler` with sanitized error responses for `AccessDenied`, `ExpiredToken`, `Throttling`, `Timeout`, `ServiceUnavailable`, and `ResourceNotFound`. Prevented all internal IAM username and AWS account ID leakage.
- Implemented **Milestone 3B (EC2 Deep Inspection)**: Extended `Ec2Provider` and `AwsEc2Provider` with `getInstance(instanceId, region, accountId)` returning rich normalized `Ec2DetailResource`. Implemented `GET /api/v1/aws/resources/ec2/{instanceId}` with safe 404 handling.
- Implemented **Milestone 3C (EBS + Network Inspection)**: Added detailed inspection models `Ec2EbsAttachment` (size, type, IOPS, throughput, encryption) and `Ec2NetworkInterfaceDetail` (ENI ID, VPC, subnet, IPs, MAC address, security groups) mapped directly from AWS SDK v2 responses.
- Implemented **Milestone 3D (CloudWatch Metrics Foundation)**: Added `software.amazon.awssdk:cloudwatch`, created `CloudWatchMetricsProvider` and `AwsCloudWatchMetricsProvider` querying AWS CloudWatch telemetry (`CPUUtilization`, `NetworkIn`, `NetworkOut`, etc.). Created `AwsObservabilityService` with strict validation (window <= 30d, period multiples of 60s) and endpoint `GET /api/v1/aws/resources/ec2/{instanceId}/metrics`.
- Implemented 43 automated unit tests with 100% pass rate.
- Verified live endpoint behavior against live AWS identity (`351405419700`) with safe error sanitization and 0 mutations.

Phase 4: S3 Deep Inspection & Storage Security Foundation
- Implemented read-only S3 deep inspection domain models: `S3DetailResource`, `S3PublicAccessBlock`, `S3BucketPolicySummary`, `S3EncryptionConfiguration`, `S3VersioningConfiguration`, `S3CorsConfiguration`, `S3LifecycleConfiguration`, `S3LifecycleRule`, `S3CorsRule`.
- Extended `S3Provider` and `AwsS3Provider` with `getBucket(bucketName, region, accountId)` querying AWS S3 configurations (`HeadBucket`, `GetBucketLocation`, `GetPublicAccessBlock`, `GetBucketEncryption`, `GetBucketVersioning`, `GetBucketPolicy`, `GetBucketCors`, `GetBucketLifecycleConfiguration`, `GetBucketTagging`).
- Implemented capability state handling (`CONFIGURED`, `NOT_CONFIGURED`, `ACCESS_DENIED`, `UNAVAILABLE`) for graceful degradation across partial IAM permissions.
- Implemented REST endpoint `GET /api/v1/aws/resources/s3/{bucketName}` with proper 404 on missing bucket and sanitized error handling.
- Expanded automated unit test suite to 51 tests with 100% pass rate.
- Verified zero AWS mutations, zero secret leakage, and evidence-first compliance.

Phase 5: RDS Deep Inspection & Database Observability Foundation
- Implemented **Milestone 5A (RDS Deep Inspection)**: Extended RdsProvider and AwsRdsProvider with getDbInstance(dbInstanceIdentifier, region, accountId) returning rich normalized RdsDetailResource (engine, version, instance class, status, AZ, multi-AZ, secondary AZ, promotion tier, deletion protection, IAM DB authentication, CA certificate, tags). Implemented GET /api/v1/aws/resources/rds/{dbInstanceIdentifier} with safe 404 handling.
- Implemented **Milestone 5B (RDS Network & Security Inspection)**: Created sub-models RdsStorageConfiguration (allocated/max storage, type, IOPS, throughput, encryption, KMS key ID), RdsBackupConfiguration (retention, window, latest restorable time, copy tags), RdsNetworkConfiguration (VPC ID, subnet group, subnet IDs, subnet AZs, security groups, public accessibility, endpoint/port), RdsMaintenanceConfiguration (maintenance window, auto minor version upgrade, pending modifications), RdsMonitoringConfiguration (enhanced monitoring, interval, IAM role ARN), RdsParameterGroupInfo, and RdsOptionGroupInfo.
- Implemented **Milestone 5C (RDS Observability)**: Extended CloudWatchMetricsProvider, AwsCloudWatchMetricsProvider, and AwsObservabilityService with getRdsMetric querying AWS/RDS telemetry (CPUUtilization, DatabaseConnections, FreeStorageSpace, FreeableMemory, etc.). Phase 6: VPC & Network Topology Deep Inspection
- Implemented **Milestone 6A (VPC Deep Inspection)**: Extended VpcProvider and AwsVpcProvider with getVpc(vpcId, region, accountId) returning normalized VpcDetailResource (primary CIDR, secondary CIDRs, IPv6 CIDRs, DHCP options ID, tenancy, default VPC flag, DNS support, DNS hostnames, tags). Implemented GET /api/v1/aws/resources/vpcs/{vpcId} with safe 404 handling.
- Implemented **Milestone 6B (Subnet & Route Topology)**: Implemented SubnetDetailResource (AZ, AZ ID, state, mapPublicIpOnLaunch, assignIpv6AddressOnCreation, available IPs, default for AZ) and RouteTableDetailResource (RouteDetail mapping destinations, gateway targets, NAT gateway targets, ENI targets, states) using AWS SDK v2 paginators.
- Implemented **Milestone 6C (Gateways, NACLs & Peering)**: Implemented InternetGatewayResource (attachment status), NatGatewayResource (connectivity type, public/private IPs, ENI), NetworkAclResource (NetworkAclRule mapping rules, protocols, actions, port ranges, ICMP), and VpcPeeringResource (requester/accepter VPCs and CIDRs, status).
- Implemented **Milestone 6D (Topology Aggregation & Governance Audit)**: Created composite VpcTopologyResource and REST endpoint GET /api/v1/aws/resources/vpcs/{vpcId}/topology. Verified 0 AWS mutations, 0 secret exposures, 0 controller SDK imports, and 47 passing unit tests.
- Executed live validation against AWS account identity (351405419700) with safe exception sanitization.

Phase 7: Security Group & Network Access Deep Inspection
- Implemented **Milestone 7A (Security Group Deep Inspection)**: Extended SecurityGroupProvider and AwsSecurityGroupProvider with getSecurityGroup(securityGroupId, region, accountId) returning normalized SecurityGroupDetailResource. Implemented GET /api/v1/aws/resources/security-groups/{securityGroupId} with safe 404 handling.
- Implemented **Milestone 7B (Rule Normalization & Access Topology)**: Implemented SecurityGroupRuleDetail and SecurityGroupReference normalizing protocol semantics, port ranges (romPort, 	oPort), IPv4 CIDRs, IPv6 CIDRs, prefix list IDs, and referenced security groups.
- Implemented **Milestone 7C (Attachment / Reverse Lookup)**: Discovered reverse attachments across network interfaces (NetworkInterfaceAttachment), EC2 compute instances (ComputeResourceAttachment), and RDS database instances (DatabaseResourceAttachment) using AWS SDK v2 paginators.

Phase 8: IAM Deep Inspection & Identity Security Foundation
- Implemented **Milestone 8A (IAM User Deep Inspection)**: Added IamUserResource, IamUserDetailResource, IamMfaDeviceInfo, IamAccessKeyMetadata, and IamPolicyAttachmentInfo. Implemented GET /api/v1/aws/resources/iam/users and GET /api/v1/aws/resources/iam/users/{userName} with zero credential leakage.
- Implemented **Milestone 8B (IAM Role & Instance Profile Inspection)**: Added IamRoleResource, IamRoleDetailResource, IamTrustStatement, and IamInstanceProfileInfo. Implemented GET /api/v1/aws/resources/iam/roles, GET /api/v1/aws/resources/iam/roles/{roleName}, and GET /api/v1/aws/resources/iam/roles/{roleName}/instance-profiles.
- Implemented **Milestone 8C (IAM Policy Deep Inspection & Normalization)**: Added IamPolicyStatement, IamPolicyDetailResource, and IamPolicyDocumentParser with URL decoding, statement array/single normalization, and condition extraction. Implemented GET /api/v1/aws/resources/iam/policies.
- Implemented **Milestone 8D (IAM Discovery Listing, Topology & Governance Audit)**: Added IamIdentityTopologyResource and endpoint GET /api/v1/aws/resources/iam/topology. Verified 0 AWS mutations, 0 secret exposures, 0 controller SDK imports, and 55 passing unit tests.
- Executed live validation against AWS account identity (351405419700) with safe exception sanitization.

Phase 9: Multi-Account AWS Discovery & STS AssumeRole Orchestration
- Implemented **Milestone 9A (Account Target Model & STS Foundation)**: Created AwsAccountTarget with strict 12-digit account ID validation, IAM role ARN validation, and deterministic role-to-account binding checks.
- Implemented **Milestone 9B (Cross-Account Discovery Context)**: Created AwsClientFactory constructing ephemeral, account-scoped AWS SDK clients via temporary STS session credentials with strict caller identity verification and account mismatch protection.
- Implemented **Milestone 9C (Multi-Account Read-Only Discovery)**: Added discoverAccount to AwsResourceDiscoveryService reusing existing discovery providers (AwsEc2Provider, AwsS3Provider, AwsRdsProvider, AwsVpcProvider, AwsSecurityGroupProvider) and exposed GET /api/v1/aws/resources/accounts/{accountId} in AwsResourceDiscoveryController.
- Implemented **Milestone 9D (Governance & Security Audit)**: Verified 0 AWS mutations, 0 secret exposures, 0 controller SDK imports, and 60 passing unit tests.
- Executed live validation against AWS account identity (351405419700) confirming safe error sanitization on unauthorized cross-account role assumptions.

Phase 10: CloudWatch Multi-Resource Metric Aggregation & Advanced Telemetry
- Implemented **Milestone 10A (CloudWatch GetMetricData Foundation)**: Added MetricDataQueryRequest, TelemetryAggregationResult, and extended CloudWatchMetricsProvider to query metric data with NextToken pagination.
- Implemented **Milestone 10B (Batching & Multi-Resource Query Orchestration)**: Implemented chunking with safe batch limit (50 queries/request) across EC2, RDS, and ENI resources in AwsCloudWatchMetricsProvider.
- Implemented **Milestone 10C (Time Range, Downsampling & Statistical Rollups)**: Built TelemetryProcessingUtils supporting chronological sorting, downsample bucketing, and statistical rollups (Average, Sum, Min, Max, Count) while preserving missing datapoints without synthesizing fake zeros.
- Implemented **Milestone 10D (Multi-Account Telemetry Safety & Final Audit)**: Added cross-account telemetry querying via Phase 9 STS AssumeRole and AwsClientFactory.createCloudWatchClient. Exposed GET /api/v1/aws/observability/metrics and GET /api/v1/aws/observability/accounts/{accountId}/metrics in AwsObservabilityController.
- Verified 0 AWS mutations, 0 secret exposures, 0 controller SDK imports, and 62 passing unit tests. Resolved TD-001.

Phase 11: AWS Cost Explorer & Financial Observability Foundation
- Implemented **Milestone 11A (Cost Explorer Provider Foundation)**: Added software.amazon.awssdk:costexplorer, configured CostExplorerClient in AwsClientConfig and AwsClientFactory. Created CostExplorerProvider and AwsCostExplorerProvider mapping unblended/amortized costs into exact BigDecimal domain models with NextPageToken pagination.
- Implemented **Milestone 11B (Time Range, Dimensions & Grouping)**: Built CostValidationUtils validating metrics (UnblendedCost, AmortizedCost), granularities (DAILY, MONTHLY), time windows (up to 12m for daily, 36m for monthly), and dimensions (SERVICE, LINKED_ACCOUNT, USAGE_TYPE).
- Implemented **Milestone 11C (Financial Observability Service & API)**: Created CostObservabilityService and CostObservabilityController exposing GET /api/v1/aws/costs and GET /api/v1/aws/costs/accounts/{accountId}.
- Implemented **Milestone 11D (Cross-Account Billing Scope & Final Governance Audit)**: Integrated Phase 9 STS AssumeRole and scoped CostExplorerClient with explicit billing scope metadata (STANDALONE_ACCOUNT, CROSS_ACCOUNT_ASSUMED). Verified 0 mutations, 0 secret exposures, 0 controller SDK imports, and 71 passing unit tests.
- Authored docs/architecture/COST-EXPLORER-FINANCIAL-OBSERVABILITY.md.
